# model.getChannel

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.6.0</span></div>

Return output channel information.

```lua
model.getChannel(Name)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Name` | string | yes | or Index (integer) |

## Returns

channel

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
local channel = model.getChannel("Ch name")
local channel = model.getChannel(0)
```
